title: Comparing the roles of f0, speech rate, and timbre in expressing and perceiving politeness in Mandarin speech.
summary: Previous research on vocal politeness has primarily focused on the acoustic correlates of polite expression and has yielded divergent findings, leaving unclear how multiple acoustic cues contribute to politeness perception. To address this gap, we conducted both speech production and perception experiments. In the production experiment, multivariate analyses showed that polite and rude utterances conveying identical linguistic content could be reliably distinguished using 11 acoustic features, with timbre contributing most prominently, followed by speech rate, whereas f0 contributed least. In the perception experiment, speech stimuli were generated by morphing between polite and rude utterances, with f0, speech rate, and timbre independently manipulated while other features were held constant. Linear mixed-effects models fitted to politeness ratings revealed timbre as the most robust cue, speech rate as the least influential, and f0 contributions varying with speaker gender and morphing direction. Latent class mixed-effects models further indicated largely consistent cue-use patterns across listeners. Although based on a limited dataset, particularly in the perception experiment, these findings provide preliminary insights into the relative roles of acoustic features in the expression and perception of vocal politeness in Mandarin and support analysing politeness as a form of prosodic mitigation.

相关性：是
标题：比较f0、语速和音色在普通话礼貌表达与感知中的作用
摘要：以往关于嗓音礼貌的研究主要聚焦于礼貌表达的声学关联特征，但研究结果存在分歧，多种声学线索如何共同影响礼貌感知尚不明确。为弥补这一空白，我们开展了言语产出和感知实验。在产出实验中，多变量分析表明，传达相同语言内容的礼貌与粗鲁话语可通过11个声学特征可靠区分，其中音色贡献最为显著，其次是语速，而f0贡献最小。在感知实验中，通过礼貌与粗鲁话语之间的形态渐变生成语音刺激，独立操控f0、语速和音色，同时保持其他特征恒定。对礼貌评分拟合的线性混合效应模型显示，音色是最稳健的线索，语速影响最小，而f0的贡献随说话者性别和渐变方向而变化。潜在类别混合效应模型进一步表明，不同听者之间的线索使用模式基本一致。尽管基于的数据集有限（尤其是感知实验），这些发现为普通话嗓音礼貌表达与感知中各声学特征的相对作用提供了初步见解，并支持将礼貌分析为一种韵律缓和形式。
关键词：礼貌；韵律缓和；音色；语速；普通话
